verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a dedicated `humanlayer automation run` command for non-interactive coding sessions from a CI job, cron machine, or server script (docs-12). Remote daemons and launch tokens let those sessions run on background hosts that the user does not attend (docs-7, docs-13, docs-27). Issue-tracker integrations can also create tasks from Jira, GitHub, and Linear tickets (docs-3, docs-16, docs-17). Scheduling relies on external cron or CI rather than a built-in trigger, and the evidence is vendor docs only. Missing for 10: native in-product scheduling or event triggers that start runs automatically, detailed docs on automation session behavior and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
